source_name: Finextra — payments and banking technology news
why_relevant: EU-level fintech trade press that reports Slovenian payments infrastructure events in English (Bankart/Nets instant payments, ACH platform switches) which local outlets cover only in Slovenian or not at all.

source_name: The Paypers — payments news
why_relevant: Dutch-based payments trade wire that picks up Slovenian scheme/processor announcements (Bankart–Nets, Flik go-live) in English, often paraphrasing vendor press releases; useful for vendor-deal signal in the payments sector.

source_name: FinTech Futures — Slovenia keyword page
why_relevant: A ready-made English-language index of Slovenia-tagged banking-technology stories (core banking, payments infrastructure deals); acts as a pointer that surfaces vendor and bank IT announcements which rarely reach general press.

source_name: European Payments Council — country insight articles
source_subtype: EU payments scheme body / industry association
why_relevant: EU scheme body publishing authored English country insights, including one on the Slovenian instant-payment environment describing the Flik scheme, its 15 participating banks and Banka Slovenije's catalyst role — structural detail unavailable in press coverage.

source_name: The Fintech Times — Slovenia market feature
why_relevant: UK fintech trade press occasionally produces English market overviews of Slovenia (digital adoption rates, regulatory alignment with the EU digital finance agenda, local fintech actors), which are useful for actor-map expansion even though they are secondary analysis.

source_name: CEE Legal Matters — Banking & Finance Slovenia comparative guide
why_relevant: Annual English-language legal guide written by Slovenian counsel; explains the regulatory perimeter, licensing and supervisory practice in English, and names law firms and institutions that can be snowballed into further sources.

source_name: Digital & Card Payment Yearbooks — Slovenia edition
why_relevant: Commercial English reference compiling Slovenian card/payment volumes, issuers and acquirers into a comparable annual dataset — the standard English aggregation of statistics otherwise dispersed across Banka Slovenije SL publications.

source_name: Central European Times
why_relevant: CEE-regional English outlet that covered the OTP–NKBM acquisition and merger plan with SKB; useful as an additional cross-check layer for Hungarian/Austrian bank moves into Slovenia, though editorially lighter than SeeNews or bne.

source_name: NLB Group Investor Relations – Ratings page
why_relevant: Issuer-side consolidated landing page listing current Moody's / S&P / Fitch ratings and linking to full agency rating reports (PDFs) for Slovenia's largest bank; the cheapest legal route to agency assessments that are otherwise paywalled.

source_name: NLB investor news – rating and MREL announcements (Slovenian/English regulated disclosures)
why_relevant: Regulated inside-information releases summarising each agency action and each supervisory/resolution decision (e.g. Bank of Slovenia MREL decision 16-03-2026 at 30.15% TREA), giving dated, quotable third-party assessment events.

source_name: Moody's Ratings – Slovenia sovereign and banking-sector research index
why_relevant: Canonical index of Moody's credit opinions, issuer comments and banking system outlooks naming Slovenian issuers; headline/rating/outlook metadata is typically visible free even when the full PDF is paywalled.

source_name: S&P Global Ratings – Banking Industry Country Risk Assessment (BICRA) updates incl. Slovenia
why_relevant: BICRA gives Slovenia a comparable economic-risk / industry-risk score against ~86 banking systems — a forward-looking structural read on the Slovenian banking sector that no domestic actor publishes.

source_name: Fitch Ratings – Slovenian bank and sovereign rating actions
why_relevant: Fitch is the most frequently cited agency in Slovenian media for both sovereign and bank actions (multi-bank actions historically covered seven Slovenian banks at once), so it is the best single agency for cross-bank comparability.

source_name: Scope Ratings – Slovenia sovereign ratings and research (European agency)
why_relevant: EU-domiciled agency publishing Slovenia sovereign rating reports free of charge; a non-paywalled alternative view on sovereign support assumptions that feed bank ratings.

source_name: Morningstar DBRS – Republic of Slovenia rating research
why_relevant: Fourth ECAI covering Slovenia; DBRS press releases are generally openly readable and include banking-sector commentary within sovereign rationale.

source_name: OTP banka d.d. (Slovenia) – Ratings page and rating-action commentary
why_relevant: Second systemic Slovenian bank (absorbed Nova KBM and SKB); publishes Moody's/Fitch actions with the bank's own commentary, giving a second comparable data point on Slovenian bank standalone credit profiles.

source_name: EBA EU-wide Transparency Exercise (Slovenia bank-level data)
why_relevant: Annual bank-by-bank dataset (capital, RWA, asset quality, sovereign exposures) in which Slovenian banks appear as named lines — the single most comparable open dataset for Slovenian bank financials.

source_name: EBA European Data Access Portal (EDAP) – Risk Dashboard, Transparency, Pillar 3
why_relevant: EDAP is now the central EU/EEA supervisory-data hub; from Q1 2026 it also hosts Pillar 3 data, so it is the master pointer to every downstream Slovenia-named EBA dataset.

source_name: ECB Supervisory Banking Statistics (SUP) – Slovenia country aggregates
why_relevant: Quarterly SSM statistics with an explicit SI country dimension (e.g. Slovenia repeatedly the EU's highest net interest margin, 3.54% Q4-2024 / 3.37% Q1-2025); machine-readable time series keyed like SUP.Q.SI.*

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – quarterly supervisory statistics press releases and PDF reports
why_relevant: Narrative quarterly commentary that names Slovenia in country league tables (NIM, NPL, CET1); easier to cite than raw series and dated for trend tracking.

source_name: Single Resolution Board – MREL dashboards, resolution decisions and Slovenia-relevant cases
why_relevant: SRB MREL policy and quarterly dashboards frame the loss-absorption requirements imposed on Slovenian banks (executed locally via Banka Slovenije decisions), and SRB handled the Slovenian Sberbank subsidiary case.

source_name: IMF Article IV / Staff Reports on the Republic of Slovenia (financial sector chapters)
why_relevant: Independent annual assessment of Slovenian banking-system soundness, asset quality and financial-stability risks, with staff concluding statements published ~2 months ahead of the full report.

source_name: ANR – Agencija za javni nadzor nad revidiranjem (public registers of auditors and audit firms)
why_relevant: Slovenia's sole competent authority for oversight of statutory audits of public-interest entities (banks included); its public registers identify which firm/partner audits each bank, and its oversight decisions reveal audit-quality findings the banks never publish.

source_name: Slovenski inštitut za revizijo (Slovenian Institute of Auditors) – standards and annual work reports
why_relevant: Sets the professional rules (strokovna pravila) auditors apply to Slovenian bank financial statements and publishes annual reports to the National Assembly; explains WHAT an auditor of a bank must test and disclose.

source_name: KPMG Slovenija – transparency reports and financial-services publications
source_subtype: Big Four firm publications / transparency report
why_relevant: Big Four transparency reports (statutory under the EU audit regulation) name the PIE clients audited — a direct route to who audits which Slovenian bank — alongside FS advisory publications.

source_name: PwC Slovenija – assurance/audit and advisory publications
why_relevant: Local Big Four practice publishing audit/assurance and sector commentary in Slovenian; source of methodology notes and occasional Slovenian banking/payments commentary plus its own transparency report.

source_name: EY Slovenija – services and insights (audit, forensics, sustainability)
why_relevant: Fourth Big Four local practice; audit and FAAS leadership named locally, and EY global FS/payments studies are localised here — useful for supply-side signals on who advises Slovenian banks.

source_name: Deloitte CEE Banking M&A Study (Slovenia among 12 covered markets)
why_relevant: The most consistent free consultancy series that treats Slovenia as a named market line — deal counts, market concentration, NPL and profitability benchmarks against 11 CEE peers; annual editions since ~2018.
